tools.name: actora_identity_list
tools.description: List all Agent IDs owned by a wallet address on BSC, Ethereum or Base.

tools.name: actora_identity_get
tools.description: Get agent details — tokenURI, metadata, existence.

tools.name: actora_identity_list_all
tools.description: List all agents with structured metadata (name, capabilities, skills, isActive). Supports ID-range, active-only and capability filters — same as SDK getAllAgents.

tools.name: actora_identity_metadata
tools.description: Get structured metadata for one agent: name, description, capabilities, skills, isActive, createdAt.

tools.name: actora_identity_exists
tools.description: Check whether an agent ID exists on-chain.

tools.name: actora_identity_total_count
tools.description: Total number of agents registered.

tools.name: actora_identity_register
tools.description: Register a new Agent on-chain. WRITE operation — returns tx payload.

tools.name: actora_subscription_plans
tools.description: Get plan details: price, period, pay token, trial days.

tools.name: actora_subscription_check
tools.description: Check if a wallet has an active subscription for an agent.

tools.name: actora_subscription_detail
tools.description: Full subscription detail including trial info, escrow status.

tools.name: actora_subscription_my_list
tools.description: List all subscription IDs for a wallet.

tools.name: actora_subscription_subscribe
tools.description: Subscribe to a plan. WRITE operation.

tools.name: actora_subscription_cancel
tools.description: Cancel a subscription. WRITE operation.

tools.name: actora_subscription_release
tools.description: Deprecated: ERC8004SubscriptionManager settles payments on subscribe/renew, so there is no escrow to release.

tools.name: actora_subscription_fee
tools.description: Get current platform fee in bps.

tools.name: actora_subscription_create_plan
tools.description: Create a subscription plan for an agent. WRITE operation. period is one of "day" | "week" | "month" | "quarter" | "year"; planType 0=subscription (default), 1=usage-based, 2=hybrid.

tools.name: actora_central_agent_list
tools.description: List centralized agents (source="central", off-chain, negative IDs — NOT on-chain NFTs). Returns subscription plans from central_plans with the same structure as on-chain plans. Public read.

tools.name: actora_central_subscription_check
tools.description: Check whether a wallet has an active subscription for a centralized agent (negative agentId). Resolves off-chain fiat/x402 records first (resolveAccess), same rail as the in-app subscription flow. Public read.

tools.name: actora_central_agent_create
tools.description: Create a centralized agent (source="central", off-chain, negative ID — NOT an on-chain NFT). Requires access_token (registered-user JWT). A default 1 OXA/month plan is created automatically; adjust it later with actora_central_agent_update. WRITE operation.

tools.name: actora_central_agent_update
tools.description: Update a centralized agent you own (PATCH semantics — only provided fields change). Requires access_token (registered-user JWT). WRITE operation.

tools.name: actora_central_subscription_subscribe
tools.description: Subscribe to a centralized agent via the x402 rail. Requires access_token (registered-user JWT). First call (without txHash) returns the payment instruction (amountWei / payTo / network); after the wallet completes the on-chain x402 transfer, call again with the resulting txHash to verify and activa

tools.name: actora_a2a_create_task
tools.description: Create an on-chain A2A task. WRITE operation.

tools.name: actora_a2a_get_task
tools.description: Get A2A task details.

tools.name: actora_a2a_complete_task
tools.description: Complete a task on-chain. WRITE operation.

tools.name: actora_a2a_my_tasks
tools.description: Get all task IDs for a wallet.

tools.name: actora_a2a_agent_card
tools.description: Get agent A2A card: name, capabilities, supported tasks.

tools.name: actora_reputation_rate
tools.description: Rate an agent (1-5). WRITE operation.

tools.name: actora_reputation_get
tools.description: Average rating and review count.

tools.name: actora_reputation_reviews
tools.description: All reviews with reviewer, rating, comment, timestamp.

tools.name: actora_config_get
tools.description: Read an agent spec/config value by key from the platform DB (not the on-chain ConfigurationRegistry).

tools.name: actora_config_list
tools.description: List all agent spec/config values for an agent from the platform DB.

tools.name: actora_config_set
tools.description: Config writes are owner-signed on the platform API (PATCH /api/v1/agents/:chain/:id); returns instructions. WRITE operation.

tools.name: actora_endpoint_list
tools.description: All registered endpoints from the platform DB (includes pending/failed).

tools.name: actora_endpoint_active
tools.description: Only live endpoints from the platform DB.

tools.name: actora_endpoint_best_mcp
tools.description: Best available MCP endpoint URL from the platform DB.

tools.name: actora_endpoint_status
tools.description: Owner-level endpoint health across all your agents — liveness counts (live / failed / pending / delisted), last probe result and retry time. Requires access_token (owner JWT).

tools.name: actora_gateway_tenant
tools.description: Get tenant profile, plan, quota.

tools.name: actora_gateway_health
tools.description: Gateway health + chain contract addresses (BSC / Ethereum / Base).

tools.name: actora_gateway_chat
tools.description: Single-turn conversation with an agent (SSE stream collected into a reply). Requires access_token (registered-user JWT).

tools.name: actora_gateway_create_session
tools.description: Create a conversation session (dialog container; idempotent). Requires access_token (registered-user JWT).

tools.name: actora_gateway_create_task
tools.description: Create a background task in a session (returns immediately with taskId; queued→running→done). May return 403 PARALLEL_TASKS_DISABLED. Requires access_token (registered-user JWT).

tools.name: actora_gateway_get_task
tools.description: Get task detail by id (status, result, error). Requires access_token (registered-user JWT).

tools.name: actora_gateway_list_tasks
tools.description: List all tasks of a session. Requires access_token (registered-user JWT).

tools.name: actora_gateway_cancel_task
tools.description: Cancel a task (queued → cancelled; running → aborted; terminal states are idempotent). Requires access_token (registered-user JWT).

tools.name: actora_listing_get
tools.description: Get the marketplace listing for an agent: visibility, pricing type, USD price, payment link. Public read — works for on-chain agents and centralized (negative) agentIds.

tools.name: actora_listing_set
tools.description: Publish or update a listing (visibility / pricing / payment link) and register the agent endpoint with a liveness probe in one call. Requires access_token (owner JWT). Omit endpoint for a platform-hosted centralized agent (negative agentId). WRITE operation.

tools.name: actora_listing_price
tools.description: Update pricing for an existing listing (subscription / per_call / free + USD cents). Requires access_token (owner JWT). WRITE operation.

tools.name: actora_listing_delist
tools.description: Remove a listing (delist) and mark its endpoints as delisted. Requires access_token (owner JWT). WRITE operation.

tools.name: actora_endpoint_probe
tools.description: Re-probe the primary endpoint of a listed agent (a2a or mcp) and return the liveness result. Requires access_token (owner JWT).

tools.name: actora_payload_key_list
tools.description: List payload-key records for an agent you own (public key, mode, chain, export count — never the private key). Requires access_token. Exporting/decrypting keys is not exposed over MCP.

tools.name: actora_tenant_plans
tools.description: List platform plans for B-side tenants (Free / Pro / Enterprise: quota, rate limit, concurrency, BYOK). Requires access_token (registered-user JWT).

tools.name: actora_tenant_usage
tools.description: Token/tool-call usage summary and daily timeline for the current tenant. Requires access_token (registered-user JWT).

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: actora_reputation_get · Private data: actora_identity_list, actora_subscription_plans, actora_subscription_check, actora_subscription_my_list, actora_central_subscription_check, actora_central_subscription_subscribe, actora_a2a_my_tasks, actora_config_get, actora_config_list, actora_endpoint_list, actora_endpoint_active, actora_endpoint_best_mcp, actora_payload_key_list, actora_tenant_usage · Public sink: actora_listing_set · Destructive: actora_listing_delist.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: actora_reputation_get · Private data: actora_identity_list, actora_subscription_plans, actora_subscription_check, actora_subscription_my_list, actora_central_subscription_check, actora_central_subscription_subscribe, actora_a2a_my_tasks, actora_config_get, actora_config_list, actora_endpoint_list, actora_endpoint_active, actora_endpoint_best_mcp, actora_payload_key_list, actora_tenant_usage · Public sink: actora_listing_set · Destructive: actora_listing_delist

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
